paper: LGB: Language Model and Graph Neural Network-Driven Social Bot Detection

datasets.access_note: Official repository states the full dataset is available through a Google Drive request with authorized/institutional contact.
required_files: user.json or user.jsonl or node.json or node.jsonl

datasets.access_note: Official repository does not treat the sample file as the full strict-reproduction dataset; request/use authorized full train/dev/test files.
datasets.strict_preflight: TwiBot-20_sample.json is insufficient for strict reproduction.

sample_data_policy: TwiBot-20_sample.json may be used for converter smoke tests only; it must not pass strict LGB reproduction or be reported as paper-level evidence.

commands.strict_pipeline: python -m benchmark.adapters.lgb_bot_detection --strict_pipeline --dataset_root G:\CISCN\dataset --artifacts_root G:\CISCN\CogGuard\subsystems\cogguard_dev\benchmark\lgb_strict --device cuda --encoder_backend transformers_roberta_sft --model_name roberta-base --seeds 42,43,44,45,46

completion_rule: Strict reproduction can be claimed only after official data passes preflight and strict gate reports strict_reproduction_complete=true.
